name: report_maintenance_issue
description: Send the caller's maintenance report to the property management team. Call exactly once, only after reading the full summary back and the caller clearly confirming it is correct. Returns a reference to read to the caller.

request_body_schema.description: The maintenance report exactly as the caller confirmed it.

caller_confirmed.description: true only if the caller clearly said the read-back summary is correct.

name.description: The caller's full name as they said it.

address.description: Full address as confirmed: flat or house number, street, town and postcode.

problems.description: Each separate problem on its own line, in the caller's words: what is wrong, where, since when, getting worse, appliance make or error code if given.

danger.description: Anything the caller said about danger (gas smell, water near electrics, flooding, no heating with someone vulnerable, cannot lock the door). Empty if none.

already_tried.description: What the caller has already tried themselves. Empty if not mentioned.

availability.description: When someone could visit or when the caller is usually home. Empty if not mentioned.

access_notes.description: Whether a contractor may contact them directly, pets, alarm, keys, parking, and whether they have photos or videos. Empty if not mentioned.
